ENGINEERED FOR SCALE

Built for industrial scale

01
Multi-Defect Taxonomy
Fine-tuned deep convolutional networks categorized across 6 primary steel surface defects: Crazing, Slag Inclusion, Surface Patches, Pitted Surface, Rolled-in Scale, and Longitudinal Scratches.
02
Grad-CAM Explainability
Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping computes exact spatial attention maps on the final conv layer (conv5_block3_out), providing zero black-box interpretability for quality engineers.
03
Sub-50ms Line Inference
Optimized tensor runtime enables real-time edge execution directly on roll-line inspection gantries operating at strip speeds exceeding 20 meters per second.
04
Automated Severity Scoring
Defects are graded into HIGH, MEDIUM, and LOW operational risk tiers with automated yield impact indices, preventing defective coils from progressing to cold rolling or galvanizing.
05
Dual Vision Synthesis
Combines deep neural feature extraction with classical computer vision (Sobel gradients, Laplacian variances, and crack vector energy) for maximum defect edge boundary delineation.
06
Enterprise Audit Trails
Standardized inspection certificates, ASTM E381 compliance logs, and exportable JSON audit records designed for integration with SAP PM, MES, and Level-2 mill automation.

Defect Classification Taxonomy & Inspection Updates

Six rigorous defect profiles validated against Tata Steel metallurgical quality assurance benchmarks.

CRACK TAXONOMY DEFECT 01

Crazing & Thermal Fatigue Cracks

Fine surface crack networks triggered by uneven heat dissipation in continuous casting molds. Detected through high-frequency gradient pooling.

View Metallurgical Specs →
SEVERITY 01 DEFECT 02

Longitudinal Abrasive Scratches

High-risk linear gouges caused by damaged table rollers or foreign metallic debris. Requires immediate coiler table halt to avoid coil downgrades.

View Mechanical Guide →
OXIDE FORMATION DEFECT 03

Rolled-in Scale & Secondary Oxidation

Scale flakes mechanically embedded into the hot strip during finish rolling passes. Tracked via multi-channel reflectance analysis.

View Descaler Guidelines →
SURFACE INTEGRITY DEFECT 04

Pitted Surface & Micro-Cavities

Localized depressions caused by roll wear or scale pullout. Grad-CAM visualizes surrounding stress concentration zones.

View Roll Wear Limits →
